activity_statements.statement: produces and distributes film and television content through Disney, Pixar, Marvel Studios, and Lucasfilm brands for theatrical release and streaming
operates Disney+ and Hulu streaming services distributing entertainment content directly to global consumers through subscription
operates ESPN as a multiplatform sports entertainment brand including seven US TV networks, ESPN+ direct-to-consumer app, and 43 linear networks in 130+ countries
operates Walt Disney World, Disneyland, Disneyland Paris, Tokyo Disney, Hong Kong Disneyland, and Shanghai Disney Resort theme parks and resorts globally
operates Disney Cruise Line offering cruise vacation experiences themed around Disney characters and franchises
licenses Disney, Pixar, Marvel, and Star Wars intellectual property to manufacturers for consumer products including toys, apparel, books, and games
operates ABC broadcast network and cable channels including Disney Channel, FX, National Geographic as linear TV distribution channels

name_reality_gap: The index label 'Entertainment Providers' is broadly accurate but significantly undersells the scale and operational complexity. Disney is simultaneously one of the world's largest theme park operators, a cruise line, a broadcaster (ABC, ESPN), a streaming service (Disney+, Hulu), a film studio, and an IP licensor. Experiences (parks + cruises) generates roughly as much revenue as entertainment media.
